title: Desktop Hanabi game-surface redesign
description:
## Description

Implement the approved desktop Hanabi surface: navy visual system, compact status hierarchy, per-color chronological tableau, split player workspaces, corrected drag-zone semantics, persistent action effects, History/Chat rail, complete authored asset set, deterministic fixtures, and real-browser proof. Mobile and tablet redesign remain out of scope.

## Success Criteria

All ten child tasks close with focused commits and evidence; dependency graph remains acyclic; the final desktop board satisfies R1-R16 from the plan; full automated checks and real-browser multiplayer/state proof pass; mobile/tablet redesign stays out of scope.
design: Source of truth: docs/plans/2026-07-19-001-feat-desktop-game-redesign-plan.md. Implement one child at a time in dependency order. Preserve the existing sub-desktop board, gameplay rules, socket shape, action effects, transition identity, concealment, and permissions. Desktop fit and deterministic fixtures land early; decorative art is independently integrated before final proof.
acceptance_criteria: All ten child tasks close with focused commits and evidence; dependency graph remains acyclic; the final desktop board satisfies R1-R16 from the plan; full automated checks and real-browser multiplayer/state proof pass; mobile/tablet redesign stays out of scope.

title: U1: Build desktop visual foundation and functional icons
description:
## Description

Create semantic navy/slate/ivory/coral tokens and reusable score, deck, send, and chat icons. This unit deliberately excludes decorative authored art so layout validation is not blocked.

## Acceptance Criteria

Semantic tokens cover table, panels, borders, ivory cards, text hierarchy, coral active state, and all firework colors; functional icons inherit currentColor and have consistent sizing/accessibility props; focus-visible and reduced-motion behavior works without relying on animation or color alone; focused tests pass.
design: Follow existing currentColor icon conventions and keep gameplay structure unchanged. Provide focus-visible and reduced-motion primitives. Expose resilient decorative-asset hooks for later integration.
acceptance_criteria: Semantic tokens cover table, panels, borders, ivory cards, text hierarchy, coral active state, and all firework colors; functional icons inherit currentColor and have consistent sizing/accessibility props; focus-visible and reduced-motion behavior works without relying on animation or color alone; focused tests pass.

title: U9: Prove and polish the desktop redesign
description:
## Description

Run full automated and real-browser verification, capture final proof, and perform at least one focused visual refinement against the approved desktop direction.

## Acceptance Criteria

Focused and full tests, typecheck, lint, and production build pass; no horizontal scroll or clipping at all viewports; 2/4/5 players, 4/5 cards, every ruleset, 0/1/6/7/10 discards, ordered/freeform mixes, activity/unread/send, spectator/disconnected/finished states are proven; two-player play/discard/clue/chat/reload/deep-link works; Chrome/Firefox/Safari smoke complete; final screenshots and state matrix are committed; one visual refinement pass is documented.
design: Use deterministic fixtures for exhaustive visual states and two isolated real players for socket behavior. Capture standard, maximum, and Chat states. Verify 1280/1366/1440/1586/1920, 200 percent zoom, reduced motion, keyboard, reload/deep-link, and cross-browser smoke.
acceptance_criteria: Focused and full tests, typecheck, lint, and production build pass; no horizontal scroll or clipping at all viewports; 2/4/5 players, 4/5 cards, every ruleset, 0/1/6/7/10 discards, ordered/freeform mixes, activity/unread/send, spectator/disconnected/finished states are proven; two-player play/discard/clue/chat/reload/deep-link works; Chrome/Firefox/Safari smoke complete; final screenshots and state matrix are committed; one visual refinement pass is documented.

title: U2: Build desktop shell, status HUD, and visual fixtures
description:
## Description

Create the exclusive wide-desktop shell, game-only header variant, turn/status HUD, and deterministic development fixture route. Validate the load-bearing three-column geometry before downstream components harden.

## Acceptance Criteria

Header shows brand slot, game code/copy/menu, turn sentence, score/max, deck, clues, and lives; zero values remain visible; named fixtures cover standard, maximum ruleset/discards, mixed workspace, activity/chat, spectator, disconnected, and finished states; production cannot navigate to fixtures; browser measurement proves the chosen gate without horizontal page scroll; narrow/lobby header remains unchanged.
design: Keep the lobby/default header unchanged. Gate fixture routes with import.meta.env.DEV and use real providers/components, never fake branches in production gameplay. Measure the maximum-state shell at 1280 and 1586; move the breakpoint upward instead of shrinking the 400x140 hand.
acceptance_criteria: Header shows brand slot, game code/copy/menu, turn sentence, score/max, deck, clues, and lives; zero values remain visible; named fixtures cover standard, maximum ruleset/discards, mixed workspace, activity/chat, spectator, disconnected, and finished states; production cannot navigate to fixtures; browser measurement proves the chosen gate without horizontal page scroll; narrow/lobby header remains unchanged.

title: U3: Build chronological per-color tableau lanes
description:
## Description

Build a desktop-only tableau with one current played tile and a complete chronological same-color discard queue in every active color lane.

## Acceptance Criteria

No progress dots, numerals, or five-card ladder; every lane has one current tile or empty target; 0,1,6,7,10 same-color discards all render in chronological DOM order without shrink/wrap/+N; duplicates remain; base, purple, rainbow, black-powder, and combined rulesets render; black-powder top follows descending sequence; empty lanes have visually hidden accessible color identity; action-transition tests remain green.
design: Derive lane order from the active ruleset. Preserve discardedTiles array order. Keep mini-card size fixed: 1-6 normal gap, 7-10 progressively overlap while exposing numerals. Preserve unique play/discard transition targets. Keep legacy tableau components as the default narrow variants.
acceptance_criteria: No progress dots, numerals, or five-card ladder; every lane has one current tile or empty target; 0,1,6,7,10 same-color discards all render in chronological DOM order without shrink/wrap/+N; duplicates remain; base, purple, rainbow, black-powder, and combined rulesets render; black-powder top follows descending sequence; empty lanes have visually hidden accessible color identity; action-transition tests remain green.

title: U4: Build split player workspaces and turn treatment
description:
## Description

Render each player as an identity rail plus a 400x140 workspace split horizontally into upper ordered and lower freeform zones, without structural labels.

## Acceptance Criteria

2,4,5 players and 4/5-card hands render stable workspaces; upper/lower cards appear across one unlabeled divider; only active in-progress player has coral/Playing treatment; finished game suppresses it; freeform overlap z-order remains; local cards remain concealed/draggable only when allowed; remote cards remain visible/read-only; notes and actions still work.
design: Cards remain one collection and use persisted coordinates. Preserve local-first stable order, concealment, permissions, notes, tooltips, transitions, spectators, and disconnected state. Coral and Playing appear only while the game is active; finished games have no active treatment.
acceptance_criteria: 2,4,5 players and 4/5-card hands render stable workspaces; upper/lower cards appear across one unlabeled divider; only active in-progress player has coral/Playing treatment; finished game suppresses it; freeform overlap z-order remains; local cards remain concealed/draggable only when allowed; remote cards remain visible/read-only; notes and actions still work.

title: U5: Align drag-zone semantics with the visible divider
description:
## Description

Unify the visual and semantic hand-zone boundary at half height and preserve legacy freeform positions through idempotent hydration normalization.

## Acceptance Criteria

Drop just above midpoint snaps/reorders; drop at/below midpoint preserves freeform; cross-zone moves never lose/duplicate tiles; bounds clamp full tile; moved overlapping freeform tile raises z; legacy y=58-69 hydrates to y=70 exactly once; second hydration is unchanged; new positions and websocket shape are unchanged; shared, server hydration, and client tests pass.
design: Use one shared midpoint constant. During hydration, shift legacy freeform y=58-69 to y=70 once while preserving x/z. Above boundary previews ordered insertion; below previews clamped freeform ghost. Preserve ordered reflow, lower-zone x/y/z, bounds, and remote read-only behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Drop just above midpoint snaps/reorders; drop at/below midpoint preserves freeform; cross-zone moves never lose/duplicate tiles; bounds clamp full tile; moved overlapping freeform tile raises z; legacy y=58-69 hydrates to y=70 exactly once; second hydration is unchanged; new positions and websocket shape are unchanged; shared, server hydration, and client tests pass.

title: U6: Separate persistent action effects from feed views
description:
## Description

Separate the one persistent action sound/highlight owner from pure latest, history, and chat selectors so tab presentation cannot disable or duplicate effects.

## Acceptance Criteria

Mixed, empty, chat-only, and game-only action arrays produce correct stable selector results; action effect hooks mount exactly once independent of selected activity tab; legacy feed retains sound/highlight behavior; focused selector and integration tests pass.
design: Mount useActionSounds and useActionHighlighter once above responsive/activity branches. Add pure selectors for newest non-chat action, gameplay history, and chat transcript. Keep rendering components side-effect free.
acceptance_criteria: Mixed, empty, chat-only, and game-only action arrays produce correct stable selector results; action effect hooks mount exactly once independent of selected activity tab; legacy feed retains sound/highlight behavior; focused selector and integration tests pass.

title: U7: Build desktop Latest, History, and Chat rail
description:
## Description

Build the desktop right rail with persistent Latest, accessible History/Chat tabs, session-local unread chat state, and the existing chat send path.

## Acceptance Criteria

Latest remains visible across tabs; History and Chat have keyboard-correct roles/focus; composer appears only in Chat when permitted; incoming remote closed-tab message increments unread; historical, own, open-tab messages do not; opening Chat clears; empty copy is No moves yet / Moves will appear here / No messages yet. Say hello.; long content scrolls inside rail; highlight/sound/transition behavior remains.
design: Keep legacy HanabiActionsPanel as the narrow default. Latest shows only newest non-chat action. Unread starts at zero, increments only for another player while Chat is closed, and clears on open. Define empty copy. Preserve action highlighting and single effects owner.
acceptance_criteria: Latest remains visible across tabs; History and Chat have keyboard-correct roles/focus; composer appears only in Chat when permitted; incoming remote closed-tab message increments unread; historical, own, open-tab messages do not; opening Chat clears; empty copy is No moves yet / Moves will appear here / No messages yet. Say hello.; long content scrolls inside rail; highlight/sound/transition behavior remains.

title: U8: Integrate and responsively gate desktop board
description:
## Description

Integrate tableau, workspaces, status, and activity into the measured three-column desktop grid with an exclusive responsive branch and intentional vertical page scroll.

## Acceptance Criteria

At chosen gate, 4-player standard game matches three-column hierarchy; 2/5-player, disconnected, spectator, finished, 7-color, and 10-discard states remain complete; no horizontal page scroll; below gate uses prior composition; no duplicate transition names or effects; source/focus order follows header, status, tableau, workspaces, activity; board tests pass.
design: Use BreakpointContext to mount exactly one tile-bearing board and one transition-target set. Keep controllers and action effects above the branch. Bound tableau and activity tracks, preserve 400px hand surface, use sticky rail only while reachable, and allow natural vertical scroll for five players/seven lanes.
acceptance_criteria: At chosen gate, 4-player standard game matches three-column hierarchy; 2/5-player, disconnected, spectator, finished, 7-color, and 10-discard states remain complete; no horizontal page scroll; below gate uses prior composition; no duplicate transition names or effects; source/focus order follows header, status, tableau, workspaces, activity; board tests pass.

title: U10: Generate and integrate desktop artwork
description:
## Description

Generate and integrate the canonical brand mark, two tile motifs, and eight monochrome all-ruleset lane emblems after the functional layout is independently usable.

## Acceptance Criteria

brand-mark, tile-face-burst, tile-back-emblem, and red/blue/green/yellow/white/purple/rainbow/black lane assets exist and are crisp at 16-64px; review sheet shows navy and ivory actual-size use; all rulesets select distinct art; art is aria-hidden; missing images do not remove information; tile tests pass; existing favicons remain untouched.
design: Final assets are optimized SVG with transparent backgrounds, no text/fonts/raster content, shared optical boxes, and CSS-controlled color except the brand. Integrate as decorative masks/backgrounds with live numerals and image-disabled fallback. Do not change favicons or lobby branding.
acceptance_criteria: brand-mark, tile-face-burst, tile-back-emblem, and red/blue/green/yellow/white/purple/rainbow/black lane assets exist and are crisp at 16-64px; review sheet shows navy and ivory actual-size use; all rulesets select distinct art; art is aria-hidden; missing images do not remove information; tile tests pass; existing favicons remain untouched.
